tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and source notes favor the two-layer siphon base, but the five rows have s_grad span only 0.018. Acquire the explicitly recommended open-branch discriminating probe before fitting, using the wide fallback rho range so a heterogeneous low-rho target is not excluded.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five pilot points directly to the siphon model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Their narrow s_grad span makes vmax and rho collinear, leaving a real parameter-identifiability ambiguity.
More costly and less targeted than the available probe that adds wide s_grad leverage.
Irrelevant to resolving the stated rho/vmax ambiguity.
